position.description: Where the tab bar goes: at the window's top, bottom, left or right.

style.description: The bar's look: regular, below a titlebar of the window's title; compact and minimal, in the titlebar at the top, minimal of the terminal's colors.

hide-when-single.description: Whether the bar hides while the window has one tab.

show-index.description: Whether each of the first nine tabs shows the keys that select it.

close-button.description: When a tab shows its close button: always, under the pointer, or never.

column-width.description: The width of the bar's column on the left or the right, in points.
